review_scope: Exact source-diff and static runner/comparability review, plus mocked runner tests; no simulator or training executed by this reviewer.

minimal_diff_proofs.run_paired_changes: Only SUPPORTED_VARIANTS whitelist and parse validation/message; historical VARIANTS and CLI defaults remain five arms.
minimal_diff_proofs.source_review_change: Append-only V5 review after exact historical source-review bytes.

runner_findings.fixed_population: Exactly original 20 development indices, original innovation seed 12729+index, only V5, 400-step full task horizon.
runner_findings.reference_binding: Requires complete validated historical 100 arms, exact identity/episodes/source references and manifest/config bytes; preserves old source identity.
runner_findings.failure_handling: Nonzero subprocess exit or invalid child creates program failure, stops new scheduling, and prevents complete-stage verdict; already running children are allowed to finish.
runner_findings.parallel_isolation: One independent process, output directory and exclusive log per original scene; original source/config/scenario checked around execution.
runner_findings.completion: Requires one verified V5 arm per scene, matching terminal semantics and complete contiguous Found/terminal trace; final denominator remains 20.
nonblocking_limitations: No new wall-clock timeout was introduced; a stuck child would require operational intervention.
The runner does not itself consume the separate source-comparability result; launch workflow must enforce that gate before V5 collection.

comparability_helper.comparison: Strict complete ordered physical signature digest, key outcomes and all complete_episode_row fields except wall_seconds; full manifest/config values and source identities checked.
comparability_helper.resolved_review_finding: Removed wall_seconds only from complete_episode_row equality to avoid false mismatch; signature and all semantic fields remain compared.
comparability_helper.runtime_equivalence_result: pending execution; static review does not claim equivalence

remaining_execution_gates: Require both selected full-episode replay controls to match before V5 development launch.
